review_text: The model endpoint has been throwing 503 errors intermittently since Tuesday's release. We had to roll back our integration.
Object detection accuracy on our warehouse footage jumped noticeably after the last model update. Great work, TP team.
Billed for 2.4M tokens but our dashboard only shows 1.1M in usage. This is the second month this has happened and support hasn't resolved it.
The prompt playground UI is fine but it's not obvious how to save a prompt template for reuse. Took me a while to find it buried in a menu.
Would love a way to pin a specific model version so our production calls don't silently shift behavior when TP updates the default.
Inference latency has crept up from ~200ms to almost 900ms over the past two weeks with no changes on our end. Is something wrong on your infra?
Onboarding was smooth and the docs actually matched the product for once. First AI vendor in a while that didn't waste my week.
Our account was suspended without warning over a supposed rate-limit violation. We were nowhere near the documented limit. Need this fixed today.
Feature works as advertised but the export format for bounding box data isn't compatible with our labeling tool without a manual conversion script.
The new fine-tuning wizard cut our setup time from a day to about twenty minutes. This is exactly what we asked for at the last QBR.
Support ticket #48213 has been open for 6 days with no response. We're paying for the enterprise SLA and this isn't it.
Model handles low-light footage much better now. Only gripe is the changelog doesn't clearly explain what changed under the hood.
Console crashed twice today while editing a pipeline, lost unsaved changes both times. This needs a fix or at least autosave.
Switched over from a competitor last month and the difference in response quality for our customer support bot has been dramatic.
Documentation for the batch inference endpoint is out of date, still references the v1 payload schema which returns errors now.
Really like the collaborative editing feature but it would help to have version history so we can revert a teammate's change.
Getting charged for a 'Pro' tier we never upgraded to. Someone on our team must have clicked something, but there's no confirmation flow to prevent accidental upgrades.
Anomaly detection on our production line footage flagged a defect pattern our own QA team had missed. Paid for itself in one week.
The model comparison tool is useful but only lets you compare two models side by side. We usually want to benchmark four or five at once.
Webhook delivery for completed jobs has been unreliable, missing about 1 in 10 callbacks. We've had to build our own polling workaround.
Great accuracy improvements this quarter. Only feedback is that GPU cost per inference went up alongside it without much explanation.
Support engineer Jordan walked us through a tricky migration on a call within an hour of us opening the ticket. Exceptional service.
Rate limit error messages don't tell you how long to wait before retrying, so we're just guessing with exponential backoff.
It works, but the UI for reviewing flagged frames is slow to load on larger video files, sometimes taking 10+ seconds per frame.
Invoice this month is nearly double last month's with no usage spike on our dashboard. Need an itemized breakdown, not just a total.
The new streaming response feature made our chat product feel dramatically snappier. Users have already noticed and commented.
Would be great to get a Python SDK method for batch uploads instead of having to hit the REST endpoint directly in a loop.
Two of our team's seats disappeared after the last billing cycle renewal. Had to re-invite them manually, wasted half a morning.
Neutral experience overall. API does what it says, but the rate limits feel low for the 'Business' tier compared to what competitors offer.
Custom model training on our own dataset finished faster than the estimated time and accuracy beat our in-house model by 6 points.
Tried to cancel our subscription and the cancel button just spins forever. Had to email support directly, which defeats the point of self-serve.
API is solid and reliable. Only real ask is better error codes, right now a lot of failures just return a generic 400 with no detail.
Model started misclassifying a category it used to handle fine after last week's silent update. No changelog entry for it either.
The AI Product Solutions team clearly listens to feedback, three things we requested last quarter shipped this release.
Docs are decent but the code samples are all in curl, would help to have official SDKs shown alongside for Python and Node.
Support closed our ticket as 'resolved' without actually fixing the underlying latency issue we reported three weeks ago.
Pricing page could be clearer about what counts as a 'training run' for billing purposes, we got surprised by an overage charge.
Uptime has been rock solid for us this quarter, zero incidents on our end. Appreciate the status page transparency too.
Export to CSV for detection results silently truncates at 10,000 rows with no warning. Found out the hard way during a client demo.
Feature request: allow scheduling model retraining jobs for off-peak hours instead of only on-demand.
